description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of two categories related to the performance or components of the Paper Copilot system, as described in the paper. The chart is divided into two distinct slices. The larger slice, occupying approximately 69.92% of the chart and colored a dark brown, is labeled “Reduction.” The smaller slice, accounting for 30.08% and colored a muted blue-gray, is labeled “Efficient deployment.” Both percentage values and their corresponding slice labels are clearly displayed within or adjacent to their respective segments. The chart does not include a legend or any other visual emphasis such as exploded slices, and the segments are arranged with the larger portion on the bottom left and the smaller portion on the top right.
